title: Sprinkler systems that need antifreeze solutions: acceptance of unlisted solutions
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: January 2025 (platform created January 30, 2025, last updated January 30, 2025)

facts.text: The bulletin clarifies acceptance of sprinkler systems that require an antifreeze solution.
The NBC(AE) and NFC(AE) reference the NFPA 13D, 13R and 13 installation standards for sprinkler systems.
Engagement with the local fire authority is necessary if the current antifreeze solution is not listed and must remain in place for the stated reasons.
